title: Excellent quality, poor performance.
text: Excellent quality, poor performance.. These glass dishes are beautiful, but there is a major flaw in design. They do not stack evenly, and because of it you can't pick up a plate from the stack without turning the entire stack around to find a finger hold. Disappointing, as they were the exact size, about 6", that I wanted.
